feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing gameplay control fixes and associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten set of summaries for all frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme variables defining OKLCH color tokens and light/dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry for the PWA with metadata, icons, and root mount point.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, display mode, and shortcuts for Traffic Jam.
frontend/public/offline.html: Styled offline fallback page that reloads automatically when connection is restored.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker enforcing online‑only gameplay while caching only offline.html and icons.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app that registers the service worker, shows the start screen, and renders the game with header/footer.
frontend/src/components/AboutHelp.tsx: Help/FAQ component explaining gameplay overview, controls, installation steps, and online requirement.
frontend/src/components/OnlineRequiredBl: Displays a full‑screen offline warning with a retry button when no internet connection is detected.
Renders the game's start screen with play, install, and share flows including dialogs and clipboard fallback handling.
frontend/src/game/controls/TouchControls: Implements mobile on‑screen left, right, and brake buttons with pointer capture and cleanup.
frontend/src/game/controls/useGameContro: Provides shared game control state with keyboard listeners and reactive subscriptions for components.
Defines the 3D game world, player movement, obstacle spawning, scoring, and frame updates using react‑three‑fiber.
frontend/src/game/TrafficJamGame.tsx: Wraps the main game scene, manages score and game state, and shows HUD and offline blocker overlays.
frontend/src/game/ui/GameHud.tsx: Displays score and a game‑over screen with restart controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and persisted identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: React hook that tracks browser online/offline status and exposes a manual recheck function.
frontend/src/hooks/usePwaInstall.ts: Manages PWA install prompts, installability state, and install flow handling for beforeinstallprompt and appinstalled events.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base/styles configuring a racing-themed color system with light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/utils/shareUrl.ts: Generates a sanitized current URL without hash fragments to avoid leaking sensitive tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radius, shadows, and animations, using custom CSS variables.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project state, scope, known issues, and existing features for a browser-based racing game.
